title: ToolListParams
description:
Params of the `tools/list` RPC.

Currently carries no fields; accepts `null` or `{}` on the wire. Reserved as `#[non_exhaustive]` so filtering fields can be added without a wire break.

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::rpc::ToolListParams; // Both null and {} are accepted on the wire. let _p: ToolListParams = serde_json::from_str("{}").unwrap(); let _p2 = ToolListParams::default(); ```
